method: Discounted historical Gamma-Poisson annual failure hazard, updated with6 current-year FDIC-listed closures; posterior predictive chance of≥1 further closing plus explicit small unreported in-window branch. Primary time-discount/weak prior, not calibrated structural banking model.

inputs.historical_weight: exp(-(2026-year)/3); all eleven years incl zero-failure years

formula: a=.5+sum(w_y*count_y)+6; b=.125+sum(w_y)+observed_years; p_future=1-(b/(b+remaining_years))**a; pYES=.005+.995*p_future. Gamma uncertainty shared across banks; no independent-bank multiplication.

limits: Annual hazard can change with regulators,CRE/funding stress, idiosyncratic losses and avoidance/merger resolutions. Exp(-age/3), weakGamma prior, hidden0.5% and continuous-time approximation are primary choices, not empirically fit. Only38historicfailures/11years; six afterOct18 vs7.72 expected underuniform calendar is weak seasonality, not stable forecast. Closures oftenFridays/holidays; no daily scheduling model. FDIClist publication canlag; rule waits for updated list and permits other official FDIC/government statements. Existing source absence not futureabsence.
